name: Disc Station Bessatsu: I Miss You.
summary: Disc Station Bessatsu: I Miss You. is a supplemental edition of Compile's long-running Disc Station digital magazine. This edition is included with an actual physical magazine, which contains interviews with various musical artists and previews of upcoming releases. The disc's content focuses on the song "i miss you." by Katsumi Tanaka. Two minigames are included: a sound-based card matching memory game and a rhythm-based whack-a-mole game, and there is also a music video and karaoke mode for two mixes of the featured song.
